D004: Delusions may exist in the form of intrusive obsessive thoughts, but repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors to neutralize them are not accompanied.
D016: Delusions exist in the form of intrusive obsessive thoughts, and repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors to neutralize them are accompanied.

D004.additional_condition: Presence of Delusional Beliefs about Body/Appearance Defects

D004: Delusional beliefs involving somatic functions or sensations may appear, but repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors to neutralize them are not accompanied.
D017: Delusional beliefs about body appearance/defects are held, and repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors to neutralize them are accompanied.

D004.key_difference: Nature of delusions and presence of other characteristic schizophrenia symptoms

D004: Other active-phase psychotic symptoms of schizophrenia are not accompanied.
D005: Other psychotic symptoms of the active phase of schizophrenia are partially accompanied.

D004: Depressive symptoms may be accompanied but appear for a relatively short period compared to the total duration of the delusion, and delusions appear continuously regardless of depressive symptoms.
D015: Depressive symptoms are accompanied, and delusions appear only during the period of the major depressive episode.

D004: Manic symptoms may be accompanied but appear for a relatively short period compared to the total duration of the delusion, and delusions appear continuously regardless of manic symptoms.
D010: Manic symptoms are accompanied, and delusions appear only during the period of the manic episode.

D004.key_difference: Duration of depressive symptoms and independent persistence of delusions

D004: Depressive symptoms may be accompanied but appear for a relatively short period compared to the total duration of the delusion; does not meet diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia.
D007: Meets diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia, and both delusions and depressive symptoms are accompanied for a long term. There is a period where delusions persist for at least 2 weeks without depressive symptoms.

D004.key_difference: Duration of manic symptoms and independent persistence of delusions

D004: Manic symptoms may be accompanied but appear for a relatively short period compared to the total duration of the delusion; does not meet diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia.
D006: Meets diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia, and both delusions and manic symptoms are accompanied for a long term. There is a period where delusions persist for at least 2 weeks without manic symptoms.
